root_idea.summary: The root centers on agreement, approach, and dealing without violence: gentleness, tact, and a manner that makes an affair easier.
root_idea.development: From this orientation, the lexicon develops meanings of gentleness and skilful handling, companionship and travel together, useful support or ease, leaning on the elbow, and several specialized bodily and animal terms.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Presented under the normalized singular citation form مِرْفَق; the Quranic form is the plural مَرَافِق.
A distinct Quranic derived nominal meaning, presented under its passive-participial citation form.
A vocalized singular variant of مِرْفَق, normalized together with the plural مَرَافِق and its lexical citation form.

senses.usage_conditions: In the Quran, the plural مَرَافِق denotes the elbows in the ablution instruction.

senses.definition: A means of benefit, ease, or useful advantage; a facility or resource.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction مِنْ أَمْرِكُمْ مِرْفَقًا, the noun denotes something by which one profits or finds ease, rather than the anatomical elbow.

senses.definition: A place or thing upon which one leans; a resting place or support.
senses.usage_conditions: The passive-participial form is substantivized as a place or means of repose and support.

senses.definition: A companion; one who accompanies another.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use denotes companions associated with one through the journey of life and its final destination.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Gentleness, softness, tenderness, graciousness, courtesy, or civil treatment; to deal gently with someone or with an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The verb may be construed with بِـ, عَلَى, or فِي and may describe applying tact to a need or undertaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Delicacy, neatness, dexterity, or skill in work or operation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is the opposite of clumsy or rough execution.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To proceed in a right, moderate, or well-judged manner in traveling or pacing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the construction رَفَقَ فِي السَّيْرِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Companionship; the state of being a companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This is a verbal noun associated with being a رَفِيق, distinct from the concrete individual companion.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To strike another person’s elbow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized transitive bodily use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To bind a camel’s arm or foreleg to its lower leg in order to restrain its movement.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The operation is described especially for a she-camel liable to return toward her accustomed home, or for a slightly lame camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel’s elbow being displaced or distorted outward from its side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of camels and related to the animal’s elbow condition.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A disorder or stoppage affecting the orifice of a she-camel’s teat, sometimes causing milk to revert, coagulate, or become mixed with blood.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized veterinary and pastoral term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The condition of a sheep or goat whose forelegs are white up to the elbows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive marking of the animal’s legs.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To accompany someone, especially as a traveling or journeying companion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III transitive construction describing companionship during a journey.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Hypocrisy or hypocritical behavior.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separately attested lexical use of the verbal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To benefit someone or be useful to him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form IV causative/useful-benefit construction.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To associate someone with another person or group.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A later usage explicitly described with بِغَيْرِهِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become traveling companions; to travel or journey together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form VI construction applying to two or more persons.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand aid, help, or assistance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form VIII verb is equated with seeking rِفْق in the sense of aid.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To profit by, gain advantage from, or make use of someone or something.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: May be construed with بِـ and may refer to using an implement, garment, or other thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To lean upon the elbow or upon a pillow used for leaning.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A bodily posture or the corresponding use of a support.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become full or filled.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form VIII resultative use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To seek or demand that someone benefit or be useful to one.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form X request for useful benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To take or use a مِرْفَقَة, a pillow on which one leans with the elbow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized Form Q.Q II usage.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A thing by means of which one seeks help or assistance.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete noun of aid or support, distinct from the abstract quality of gentleness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Easy of attainment or access.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of pasture, water, or a desired object that is readily sought and obtained.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company or group of people traveling together.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term applies while the travelers remain gathered in one journey or place of assembly; it ceases to apply when they separate.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A company of camels used by people traveling to obtain provisions from towns or villages.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized plural use for provisioning caravans.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A cord used to bind a camel’s elbow or arm to its lower leg.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term names the restraining cord described in the corresponding camel practice.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A finger-shaped device placed over a she-camel’s diseased teat and secured beneath the teat-binding cord.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used as a treatment for the disorder called رَفَق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Easy or convenient for someone; favorable to one’s circumstances.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative use applied to an affair or thing, commonly with بِكَ or عَلَيْكَ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More or most gentle; by extension, more or most easy or convenient.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A comparative or superlative adjective derived from the gentleness and convenience senses.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a camel: having the elbow distorted outward from the side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal epithet; the feminine form is also reported for a she-camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a she-camel: having the orifice or orifices of the teat stopped up.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal epithet associated with the teat disorder رَفَق.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A household facility or appurtenance, such as a privy, kitchen, sink, or similar convenience.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This pluralized architectural use is distinct from the anatomical elbow and from a general means of benefit.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A pillow or cushion on which one leans with the elbow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A derived noun naming the support used in leaning.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sheep or goat whose forelegs are white up to the elbows.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An animal-description term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel whose elbow hurts or presses against its side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal noun.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A she-camel injured by the cord or binding applied to her udder, with blood issuing when she is released or milked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized pastoral term associated with binding the udder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A camel suffering from a complaint of the elbow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A passive-participial animal description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Leaning upon the elbow.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The active participle describes the person adopting this posture, not the place or support itself.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Full, standing, continuing, or nearly full.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A separate, rare descriptive use attested in poetic discussion of filled or abundant low ground and vegetation.
